who_pays: Proesis Bio pays you on a reloadable prepaid Visa debit card (Paysign), issued at your first donation.
who_qualifies: You must be 18+, weigh at least 110 lbs, be in good health, and bring ID, SSN, and proof of address — then pass the screening and physical. Every visit re-screens you; failing means no donation and no pay.
work_available: Proesis operates centers in Houston, Dallas, Katy TX, Raleigh NC, and Meridian ID only — useless outside those markets. Per-center pay transparency is unusually good, but amounts vary by center, so check your center's page before choosing where to sign up.
what_gets_accepted: Completed donations only — pass the day's health screening and finish the donation. The $50 extra on the first 5 donations applies to your first 5; the $30 frequency bonus requires 2 donations per 7-day window.
costs_and_unpaid_time: The first donation takes about 2 hours with screening before any pay; return visits run about 90-180 minutes. A needle in your arm, twice-weekly trips, travel and waiting — all unpaid.
when_cash_arrives: Paid per donation onto your reloadable prepaid Visa debit card, issued at your first donation.
